title: ConformAtlas: mapping conformational landscapes from molecular simulations
description: ConformAtlas is a Python package and command-line tool for the analysis of molecular dynamics trajectories: least-squares superposition, Cartesian/dihedral PCA and TICA, Boltzmann-inverted free energy landscapes with block-bootstrap uncertainties, topological (watershed) state segmentation with barriers and lag-1 kinetics, convergence diagnostics (RMSIP, cosine content, statistical inefficiency and effective sample size, equilibration detection), and multi-system comparisons in a shared PCA space with population-difference statistics. Every numerical component is validated against analytical results or independent implementations (MDAnalysis, GROMACS, pymbar, deeptime, SciPy, ProDy); the validation report ships with the package.
